name: 2econd 2kin Magazine
outcome: An editorial world that leads naturally into the collection.

caseStudy.problem: An independent magazine needs more than a place to publish. Its digital experience should carry the same character as the work and invite readers to keep exploring.
caseStudy.whatWeBuilt: A connected magazine, lookbook, and shop with a consistent visual identity. Photography leads the experience, while clear navigation keeps the collection within reach.
caseStudy.results: Let the work create interest, then give that interest a direction. The path from magazine to lookbook to shop is designed to feel like one continuous experience.
